title: SSH access
opening: YubiKey: enter PIN and touch. Do not retry an incorrect PIN.
closedHint: Closing only revokes access for new sessions. Existing sessions may continue and can no longer be counted.
countHint: Counts shells, commands and file sessions on this master, not pure port forwarding or previously closed masters.
empty: No named SSH hosts found. Add hosts in ~/.ssh/config.
pollError: SSH status unavailable. Refresh or check your SSH configuration.
pollingOff: Automatic refresh disabled. Refresh to check.
pollingOn: Local status check every 10 seconds, every 3 seconds with this menu open. No network connection is opened.
